claim: On October 23, 2009 Jeffrey Epstein forwarded a passage from the shipping trade press about forward freight agreements to Roger Schank, an artificial-intelligence and education researcher who founded Engines for Education. Above the article Epstein wrote: "This is the way the jew make money.. and made a fortune in the past ten years,, selling short the shippping futures,, let the goyim deal in the real world." Schank replied the same morning: "how jews make money I understand; in the blood; did you know that I had a family business that I made quite clear I wasnt taking over? it was a fight; it dealt in real stuff -- lots of it; they should have traded bead futures." The exchange is Bates EFTA00771953 in Data Set 9 of the Department of Justice release, with further produced copies at EFTA00885615 and EFTA00741068.

notes: Backstage. This record corrects an earlier one on this site. 2026-byington-claims-vs-corpus-001 reported that the Schank-Epstein correspondence was about Gates Foundation education policy rather than the quoted content — true of every Schank document in the published /efta/ subset, and wrong about the release as a whole. That search ran against the 4,333-document curated cache instead of the full 1,051,599-document corpus, where the email is present in three copies. The verbatim is reproduced with its original doubled commas, misspellings and the low-comma OCR of the double comma left intact. Schank is correctly described here as an AI and education researcher; the separate circulating description of him as a hedge-fund worker remains wrong. Group A.
